attchmntText: Jubilant Pharmova Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Press Release on financial Results".
voiceSummary: Jubilant Pharmova Limited approved financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Revenue for the quarter stood at Rs. 2,370 Cr, reflecting a 21% year-on-year growth. Total income was Rs. 2,384 Cr. EBITDA was Rs. 255 Cr with a margin of 10.7%. Reported profit after tax was Rs. 31 Cr. For the half year, revenue grew 19% to Rs. 4,599 Cr. EBITDA was Rs. 523 Cr. Reported PAT was Rs. 87 Cr. The company raised Rs. 800 Cr through non-convertible debentures for debt refinancing and capital expenditure. The Board met on November 13, 2026, to approve these results.

attchmntText: Jubilant Pharmova Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Jubilant Pharmova Limited’s Board approved standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. Standalone revenue from operations was 685 million rupees for the quarter and 1,356 million rupees for the half-year. Standalone profit after tax was 73 million rupees for the quarter and 149 million rupees for the half-year. Earnings per share were 0.48 rupees for the quarter and 0.94 rupees for the half-year. The company allotted unsecured non-convertible debentures aggregating 8,000 million rupees on November 5, 2026. Total assets stood at 24,576 million rupees as of September 30, 2026. The limited review report by Walker Chandiok and Co LLP indicated no material misstatements.

attchmntText: Jubilant Pharmova Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 10, 2026, titled "Jubilant Therapeutics Announces Oral Presentation of Preliminary Phase 1 Clinical Data for JBI-802, a First-in-Class Oral Dual LSD1/HDAC6 Inhibitor, in Essential Thrombocythemia and Related Myeloproliferative Neoplasms at the 68th ASH Annual Meeting".
voiceSummary: Jubilant Pharmova submitted a press release regarding its subsidiary, Jubilant Therapeutics. The release announces the oral presentation of preliminary Phase 1 clinical data for JBI-802 at the 68th ASH Annual Meeting. JBI-802 is a first-in-class oral dual LSD1/HDAC6 inhibitor. The data covers patients with essential thrombocythemia and related myeloproliferative neoplasms. Key findings show rapid platelet reductions and durable hematologic control. The presentation is scheduled for December 14, 2026. The company will host a corporate event on the same date. The press release was filed on November 10, 2026.
